2026-02-04.pinyin: Jīntiān èr yuè sì hào. Xiànzài shì bā diǎn bàn. Zǎoshang wǒ yào chī zǎofàn le.
2026-02-04.english: Today is February 4th. It is now 8:30am. This morning I am going to eat breakfast.
2026-02-04.chinese: 今天二月四号。现在是八点半。早上我要吃早饭了。

2026-02-04.pinyin: Shàngwǔ shì jiǔ diǎn. Wǒ zài gōngzuò.
2026-02-04.english: It's 9am in the morning. I am working.

2026-02-04.pinyin: Zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn. Wǒ chī wǔfàn le.
2026-02-04.english: It's 12 o'clock noon. I ate lunch.
2026-02-04.chinese: 中午十二点。我吃午饭了。

2026-02-04.pinyin: Xiàwǔ sān diǎn. Wǒ hái zài gōngzuò.
2026-02-04.english: It's 3pm in the afternoon. I am still working.

2026-02-04.pinyin: Xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn. Wǒ qù jiàn wǒ de péngyǒu Chris.
2026-02-04.english: It's 5pm in the evening. I am going to meet my friend Chris.
2026-02-04.chinese: 下午五点。我去见我的朋友Chris。

2026-02-04.pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒmen chī wǎnfàn le. Xiànzài shì bā diǎn.
2026-02-04.english: In the evening we ate dinner. It is now 8 o'clock.
2026-02-04.chinese: 晚上我们吃晚饭了。现在是八点。

2026-02-07.pinyin: Nǐ shénme shíhòu chī zǎofàn？ Wǒ bā diǎn bàn chī zǎofàn.
2026-02-07.english: When do you eat breakfast? I eat breakfast at 8:30.
2026-02-07.chinese: 你什么时候吃早饭？我八点半吃早饭。

2026-02-07.pinyin: Nǐ shénme shíhòu qǐchuáng? Wǒ bā diǎn qǐchuáng.
2026-02-07.english: When do you wake up? I wake up at 8 o'clock.
2026-02-07.chinese: 你什么时候起床？我八点起床。

2026-02-07.pinyin: Nǐ shénme shíhòu qù gōngzuò? Wǒ zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn qù gōngzuò.
2026-02-07.english: When do you go to work? I go to work at 9am in the morning.
2026-02-07.chinese: 你什么时候去工作？我早上九点去工作。

2026-02-07.pinyin: Nǐ shénme shíhòu huí jiā? Wǒ wǎnshang huí jiā.
2026-02-07.english: When do you go home? I go home in the evening.
2026-02-07.chinese: 你什么时候回家？我晚上回家。
